function.name: LOAD_WAV
function.abstract: It recovers of disk a sound effect archive

description.p: This function loads an archive in WAV format of disk and puts on memory to play it by the function . The value that the function returns is an entire number that represent the resort on memory, or -1 if it was not possible to load the archive or if it was not a valid format.
If you do not want to use more the sound effect, you can unload it of memory using the function .
